module: Handlers for the player's camera inputs (look, move, zoom, absolute 3D mouse/SpaceMouse axes), extracted from core/camera.lua. It is not an extension: camera.lua does require('core/cameraInput'), injects moveFor and getFovDeg into it via setup(), then re-exposes these functions on core_camera (input actions call core_camera.rotate_yaw, etc.). They write to the player's MoveManager structure (fields yawLeft, yawRight, pitchUp, pitchDown, rollLeft, rollRight, forward, backward, left, right, up, down, zoomIn, zoomOut, yawRelative, pitchRelative, rollRelative, absXAxis, absYAxis, absZAxis), which the camera modes then read.
usage:
-- Normally called by the input bindings:
core_camera.rotate_yaw(0.5, FILTER_PAD, 0)  -- turn right at 50%
core_camera.moveforward(1, 0)
notes: The player argument is the player index (0 by default); moveFor(player) returns the MoveManager structure of that player's view.
'Relative' rotations (mouse) are scaled by the field of view: delta = fovDeg * val / 4500.
For 3D absolute axes: rotation factor 0.0005, translation factor 0.02; the value is the difference between the previous and the new value (so a delta).
yAxisMoveStep moves forward at speed val for 0.05 s (tickAbsAxes then resets the axes to 0).
yAxisMoveStep has no effect if editor.disableCameraZoom is true or if a cameraControllerRegistry controller consumes onEditorMouseWheel.
Inconsistency: yawAbs/rollAbs/pitchAbs/xAxisAbs/yAxisAbs/zAxisAbs write to the global MoveManager (not to moveFor(player)): they therefore do not handle multiple players.
Inconsistency: the moveleft/moveright/moveforward/... functions (lowercase) assign the value directly, whereas moveForwardBackward/moveLeftRight handle a signed axis.

setup.desc: Dependency injection by camera.lua: functions moveFor(player) and getFovDeg().

getLastFilter.desc: Last input source type used to rotate the camera (FILTER_KBD keyboard, FILTER_PAD gamepad, FILTER_MOUSE mouse). Read by the camera modes and the UI.

timeSinceLastRotation.desc: Time elapsed since this player's last camera rotation.

getLastCameraMovementType.desc: Type of the last camera rotation: 'absolute' (axes/keys), 'relative' (mouse) or 'none'.

rotate_yaw_left.desc: Sets the left yaw input and stores the filter and the rotation time.

rotate_yaw.desc: Signed yaw axis: val > 0 sets yawRight and cancels yawLeft, val <= 0 the opposite.

rotate_pitch.desc: Signed pitch axis: val > 0 sets pitchUp and cancels pitchDown, otherwise the opposite.

moveForwardBackward.desc: Signed forward/backward axis: val > 0 sets forward, otherwise backward = -val.

moveLeftRight.desc: Signed left/right axis: val > 0 sets right, otherwise left = -val.

cameraZoom.desc: Signed zoom axis: val > 0 sets zoomIn, otherwise zoomOut = -val.

rotate_yaw_relative.desc: Relative (mouse) yaw rotation. First offers the event to the controller registry (onRelativeInput 'yaw'); if not consumed, adds fov*val/4500 to yawRelative.

rotate_pitch_relative.desc: Relative (mouse) pitch rotation, same principle as rotate_yaw_relative with 'pitch'.

moveleft.desc: Move-left key (free camera or driver seat adjustment): sets moveFor(player).left.

yawAbs.desc: Absolute yaw axis (3D mouse): MoveManager.yawRelative = (previous - val) * 0.0005.

rollAbs.desc: Absolute roll axis (3D mouse), same principle as yawAbs on rollRelative.

pitchAbs.desc: Absolute pitch axis (3D mouse), same principle on pitchRelative.

xAxisAbs.desc: Absolute X translation axis (3D mouse): MoveManager.absXAxis = (previous - val) * 0.02.

yAxisAbs.desc: Absolute Y translation axis (3D mouse): MoveManager.absYAxis = (previous - val) * 0.02.

zAxisAbs.desc: Absolute Z translation axis (3D mouse): MoveManager.absZAxis = (previous - val) * 0.02.

yAxisMoveStep.desc: Small-step movement (3D mouse wheel zoom): moves forward at speed val for 0.05 s. Ignored if camera zoom is disabled in the editor or consumed by a controller (onEditorMouseWheel, val/20).

tickAbsAxes.desc: Called every frame by the main view: resets the absolute translation axes to zero once the 0.05 s window has elapsed.
